method: Three serial interleaved rounds of baseline/editor-only/presenter-only/both; ten seconds per sample; original user app remained running; no concurrent checks. Audience quality/viewport/DPR unchanged. rAF callbacks and shader publications, not physical-display FPS.
instrumentationNote: Editor window contains duplicate effect IDs across canvas and dock. Raw per-ID editor publication deltas from the comparison are excluded because their attribution is ambiguous; independent lifecycle validation keys by DOM instance index. CDP window task metrics are retained and are busy task duration, not pure CPU utilization.
